text: What is the thermal noise floor per hertz at room temperature (290 K)?
explanation: kT at 290 K is 4.00e-21 W/Hz, which is -174 dBm/Hz. For a given bandwidth, add 10log10(B): a 20 MHz channel has a thermal floor of about -101 dBm, and a real receiver's noise figure adds another 4-10 dB on top.
